name: Port Wakefield Modular Data Centre (Ashur Digital Labs)
notes: 2MW modular data centre colocated on an existing solar farm in the Port Wakefield region; INTREC designed the 2MW substation for the 33kV high-voltage connection integrated with the solar energy system. Source is a contractor portfolio page only - no planning/energy primary record located; status and capacity unverified (grade C). Capacity basis: module/connection capacity, not IT load.

name: Whyalla Regional Data Centre
notes: 5MW regional data centre designed and constructed by INTREC for client Intrec Energy to meet growing regional demand. Contractor portfolio page only; no planning register (PlanSA) or energy (ElectraNet) record located; status/capacity unverified (grade C).

name: Cultana / Whyalla AI data centre proposal
notes: Speculative lead for an AI data centre at Cultana near Whyalla (site previously earmarked for a hydrogen plant); SA Government data centre & AI infrastructure strategy (June 2026) explicitly targets the Mid North and Whyalla for AI data centre investment and plans dedicated legislation. No operator, facility scope or planning application verified - lead only (grade C).

name: Viridis Green Data Centres Burnie edge data centre
developer: VIRIDIS Green Data Centres (landlord: Arcana Capital)
notes: Tier III Zone 4 edge data centre in Burnie CBD (former Advocate newspaper print centre); ~1MW draw from existing grid connection, 1,215 sqm, free-air cooling plus staged solar/battery/hydrogen clean-burn microgrid. Burnie City Council issued the permit under s.51/s.57 Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993 (Clause 6.8 Tasmanian Planning Scheme) as Storage Use (Data Centre), no conditions; target go-live H1 2027. Capacity basis: ~1MW grid draw, not IT load.

name: Energy Estate Digital NW Tasmania data centre hub (IndoMaris cable landing)
notes: Company announcement (Dec 2025): subsea data cable landings in NW Tasmania (IndoMaris cable lands close to Burnie) to support AI factory/data centre campuses in energy precincts. MOU/planning-lead level; no facility scope, capacity or LGA-specific planning for Burnie verified (grade C).
